nextStoryContext: US-003 (CAM-203) closes the plan-target-invalid loop end-to-end. Wiring recap: makeProductionPlanPhaseFn's runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan now passes `planTargetId: planIssue` into runPlanPhaseWithReplan alongside the existing `selectIssueFn: () => selectPlanTargetFromFile(cwd, planIssue)` -- both read the SAME fresh plan_issue value each invocation, so the label (planTargetId, used only for the plan-target-invalid terminal's targetId) and the actual selection (selectIssueFn) can never drift out of sync for a given tick. runPostAuditAction gained a `handlePlanTargetInvalid(targetId, notifyFn, logEvent)` helper (extracted to stay under biome's 80-line-per-function ceiling) that fires notifyFn (orchestrator-pane push naming the target) + logEvent (new 'plan-target-invalid' WorkerEventKind, detail `{ targetId }`) and returns `{ kind: 'no-action' }` -- deliberately NO escalateFn call (operator-input error, not an infra alert, same reasoning as the pre-existing planner-failed branch). RunPostAuditOptions gained an optional `logEvent?: WorkerEventLogger` field; sidecar.ts's runPostPlanActions threads `logEvent: o.logEvent` through (PostPlanActionsOpts gained a `logEvent: WorkerEventLogger` field, and makeProductionPlanPhaseFn's call site was updated to pass its closure-scoped logEvent in). IMPORTANT DISCOVERY (saved a whole sub-story): the 'stale plan_issue cleared' requirement needed ZERO new code. makeSetPhaseFn(claudeDir, cwd) already has the signature `(phase, planIssue?: string) => void`, and its body writes `plan_issue: planIssue` (the raw 2nd ARGUMENT) into renderStateFile -- it never falls back to the previously-parsed state file's plan_issue value. exitPhaseAfterPlan (unexported, sidecar.ts) already calls `setPhase('idle')` with only one arg for every non-branch-created outcome (including the new no-action from plan-target-invalid), so plan_issue is cleared to null as a pure side effect of the pre-existing idle-exit call. No second writer, no special-case branch needed for that part of AC3. Test coverage: test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts gained a 'plan-target-invalid path (US-003, CAM-203)' describe block (9 tests: no-action kind, notifyFn naming target, escalateFn never called, structured event via makeInMemoryEventLogger, absent-logEvent safety, no git calls, setPhaseFn not called directly by runPostAuditAction itself, removeEscalationMarkerFn not called). New file test/plan-target-invalid-sidecar.test.ts covers: AC1 source-text oracle proving planTargetId is wired INSIDE runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan's actual runPlanPhaseWithReplan call (not just present anywhere in the file), AC2 source-text oracle proving runPostPlanActions/makeProductionPlanPhaseFn thread logEvent through, AC3/AC4 a FUNCTIONAL test with a real temp .claude/cam-loop.local.md: seeds phase:planning+plan_issue:CAM-777 via makeSetPhaseFn, runs runPostAuditAction for a plan-target-invalid result (real notifyFn/logEvent capture, asserts no-action + zero git calls), then mirrors exitPhaseAfterPlan's idle-exit call and asserts the FINAL on-disk state is phase:idle + plan_issue:null, and AC5 registration checks. Ratchet note: scripts/file-size-budget.json ceilings were raised for sidecar.ts (1994->2002), events.ts (507->524), and plan-runner.ts (1116->1164), each with the CAM-203 tracker ref inline in _ref (per the ratchet gate's staged-diff tracker-ref requirement). US-004 (auto-dispatcher honoring a pending explicit plan_issue) is the next story on this branch: it likely needs to verify/wire the meta-loop auto-dispatcher (makeProductionMetaLoopDispatchFn / MetaLoopDispatchDeps in sidecar.ts) so that when it writes phase:planning + plan_issue:<id> via setPhaseFn, a SUBSEQUENT auto-dispatch tick does not silently overwrite or race a still-pending explicit plan_issue with a different auto-selected issue before the plan phase actually consumes it -- check that story's exact AC wording, since the plan-runner side (this story + US-001/US-002) is now fully wired end-to-end and should not need further changes.
